Fueled by Collaboration and Curiosity: My Journey in AI
College wasn't just about textbooks for me. It was a launchpad for my passion in Artificial Intelligence (AI), fueled by collaboration and a relentless hunger for knowledge. My natural ability to connect with people led to strong bonds with classmates and professors, creating a network that fueled my learning.

Leading major projects in my first and second years was a turning point. The collaborative spirit fostered a sense of shared responsibility, pushing us to achieve something significant together. We learned from each other's strengths, tackled challenges as a unit, and celebrated collective success. This teamwork translated into two research papers: the first, a collaborative effort highlighting the value of diverse perspectives, the second, based on my own research, boosting my confidence in tackling complex problems solo.

My thirst for knowledge extended beyond assigned projects. My fascination with AI drew me into professors' research projects. Working alongside them wasn't just contributing; it was a masterclass in cutting-edge methodologies. Witnessing theory translated into real-world applications deepened my understanding of AI.

This desire to learn went beyond the classroom. Helping classmates with coding and projects solidified my own knowledge. Explaining concepts, debugging code, and collaborating served as a powerful tool for self-learning.

My drive to learn extends beyond the curriculum. I actively explore new AI technologies, staying at the forefront of advancements. This insatiable curiosity fuels my passion.

I actively sought peer feedback on projects, valuing their insights. These conversations not only improved my work but also fostered intellectual exchange.

The most enriching conversations were with professors. My genuine interest in AI, particularly medical imaging, opened doors for collaboration. These discussions often led to opportunities to contribute to their research, providing invaluable hands-on experience.

College became a breeding ground for my AI passion. It was a time of exploration, collaboration, and ultimately, a commitment to developing real-world solutions through machine and deep learning. Each project, conversation, and challenge has been a stepping stone towards making a positive impact on the world through AI.

My Internship Experience at Robro Systems

During my internship at Robro Systems, I worked on enhancing machine vision capabilities. My tasks focused on image processing, training classifiers, and visualizing performance metrics.

Image Processing and Synthetic Data Generation: I was responsible for processing images and generating synthetic data to augment our dataset. This included pre-processing images for consistency and quality, and creating synthetic doubles to address data scarcity and imbalance.

Training the YOLOv3 Classifier: I trained the YOLOv3 classifier within the Darknet framework. This involved feeding the model a large dataset of real and synthetic images, iteratively adjusting the model's parameters and architecture for optimal performance, and ensuring the classifier accurately detected and recognized objects in real-time.

Performance Monitoring and Visualization: To evaluate model effectiveness, I connected the YOLOv3 classifier to Power BI for real-time monitoring. This included creating interactive dashboards displaying key performance metrics like precision and recall, analyzing these metrics to understand model performance and identify improvement areas, and providing detailed visual reports to support decision-making and further model optimization.

Project Highlights: Successfully integrating synthetic doubles into the training dataset enhanced the dataset's diversity and robustness, improving the model's generalization and performance on unseen data. Iterative training and fine-tuning significantly improved the YOLOv3 classifier's accuracy. This involved testing various configurations and learning rates, conducting thorough evaluations using precision and recall metrics, and implementing feedback loops based on real-time analysis. Developing detailed and interactive reports in Power BI provided clear, actionable insights into the model's performance, identified trends for further development.
